verdict.rationale: Linear's API is GraphQL, and the official docs say the endpoint supports introspection, so the whole schema can be queried programmatically. The full SDL is also published as schema.graphql in the official linear/linear repo, a downloadable machine-readable spec that serves as the GraphQL equivalent of OpenAPI, and Apollo Studio offers schema browsing with no login. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the schema download or introspection works as documented, and no OpenAPI-format spec specifically.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
